entries.basis: Yelnykov 2025 (SRC-17A7CA53F7DB) publishes a fourteenth-century Arabic bronze bowl with silver inlay from the Velyki Kuchugury hillfort. Mike ruled on 2026-09-27 that a fourteenth-century metal bowl is outside the corpus of late-antique incantation bowls. 'non_bowl' here means not an in-scope incantation bowl; the record and its source are kept.
